approved_scope.title: The build fingerprint frames the compile configuration as well as the sources
approved_scope.description: The build fingerprint frames the compile configuration as well as the sources
approved_scope.no_spec_change_rationale: REQ-hash-cache-005 and REQ-change-134 say a cached result is replayed only by the build that recorded it, and CHECK-1.d says a remembered result never hides a failure the running build would report; two builds of one tree for another target, profile or feature set shared one fingerprint (#981)
acceptance_criteria: build.rs frames TARGET, PROFILE, OPT_LEVEL, DEBUG and every CARGO_CFG_* and CARGO_FEATURE_* variable into SPECSYNC_BUILD_FINGERPRINT and records them as SPECSYNC_BUILD_CONFIGURATION; two configurations of one tree frame differently, and the same configuration frames the same whatever else is set
